title: The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path…
description: The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 3.2.2 contains a vulnerability in the theme_delete function that allows authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher to delete arbitrary files on the server. This occurs due to insufficient file path validation. Exploitation requires a specific site configuration where an administrator has created a custom wpForo secondary usergroup with a blank WordPress role and the 'mth' (Manage Themes) capability. Attackers can self-register and exploit an unguarded POST field to gain theme-management access and delete critical files, potentially leading to remote code execution.
